assets.label: 组件视觉参考板
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: visual reference board for Arena UI, a premium dark fantasy game web component library. Generate a meticulously art-directed 1536x1024 landscape UI component specimen board on nearly black #0e1116. Modular neatly aligned grid with generous spacing, beautifully crafted thin metallic line work, warm gold #f2b632 primary action, cyan #3ec7e0 selection, blue-gray #171c24 surfaces, sharp 2px-radius corners. Top understated typography reads 'ARENA UI' and 'COMPONENT COLLECTION'. Include a top left group of gold, dark outlined secondary, and red outlined danger action buttons labeled 'BATTLE', 'EQUIP', 'DISMANTLE'; three HP red, MP cyan and XP gold progress bars with numerical labels; a tasteful dark character statistics panel; eight fantasy inventory cells with sword, shield, violet ring, red potion, axe, helmet, scroll and cyan crystal; a gold-accented modal with 'READY TO BATTLE?' and two action buttons; a tab navigation strip; a few small status badges and control switches. Flat front-facing interface layout, typography crisp and minimal, no perspective, no device, no desk, no watermarks. This is a visual exploration image, all important labels must look clean and restrained.

assets.label: 装备图集
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game inventory icon atlas. Generate one landscape 1536x1024 image with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows of equal cells, no gutters, every object centered and fully contained with 20% margin in its own cell. Flat opaque uniform background #171c24 across whole sheet. Row1 left to right: elegant silver longsword with gold guard, reinforced silver and dark steel shield with cyan gemstone, delicate gold ring with violet gemstone, small round glass potion flask with red liquid. Row2 left to right: double headed dark iron battle axe, steel hornless knight helmet, rolled aged parchment scroll with gold seal, cluster of glowing cyan crystals. Hand painted 3D fantasy inventory assets, realistic metal highlights, sculptural depth, coherent top-left lighting and consistent scale. Rich detail clearly readable at small size. No UI frames, borders, labels, numbers, text, characters, watermarks. Every object isolated inside exactly its own 4-by-2 grid cell. Do not let objects overlap cells.

assets.label: Q版·元素攻势技能图集
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable combat skill icon atlas for an arena and character-growth mobile game. Charming chibi fantasy game art, big heads and compact two-head-tall bodies for characters, rounded chunky shapes, warm cream background where opaque, cocoa outlines, soft hand-painted toy-like 3D depth, broad clean highlights, matte materials, clear silhouettes. Honey gold for actions and rewards, sky cyan for selection and energy, coral only for health or danger, mint only for healing, lavender only for epic rarity. No gritty dark metal, photorealism, sharp gothic spikes or realistic adult proportions. Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 image, EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows of equally sized cells, eight independent skill icon groups. No gutters or visible grid lines. Flat opaque uniform cream #fff7e7 across the whole sheet, not transparent. Center every complete icon in its cell. All tips, local shadows and effects must fit within the CENTRAL 60 percent of that cell in BOTH axes, leaving at least 20 percent clear margin on all four sides. Do not cross cell boundaries. Rounded chunky forms, cocoa #654c3f outlines, matte cream materials and cocoa wood/leather where needed, soft toy-like hand-painted depth, broad restrained top-left highlights and distinct silhouettes readable at small mobile UI sizes. Honey gold #ffc857 for action and reward, sky cyan #60c9e8 for energy, coral #ed777b only for damage/health/danger, mint #7ecf9e only for healing. Omit lavender because these are ordinary skills. No gritty metal, photorealism, gothic spikes, full characters, scenery, text, letters, numbers, labels, UI frames, logos, watermarks, broad glows or particles outside the icon footprint. Eight new elemental and damage skills, left to right. ROW ONE: 1 one rounded cream meteor stone with a short coral flame tail for meteor impact, no ground or crater; 2 one compact curling cyan water wave with two tiny attached cream foam lobes for tidal push; 3 one cocoa vine loop with four short rounded coral thorns for bramble damage, no leaves; 4 three thick parallel coral claw streaks over one small cocoa slash mark for claw strike, no animal. ROW TWO: 5 one compact coral three-tongued flame burst with a cream inner flame for fire burst; 6 one squat cyan spiral whirlwind tapering to a cream base for wind strike, no loose debris; 7 three short cream earth spires rising from a tiny cocoa base with two coral impact cracks for earth rupture, a single contained group; 8 one thick cyan magical crescent with a cream inner rim and two tiny attached cyan energy ticks for moon arc. These are static ability symbols, not animated frames. Avoid sword slash, ice spear, lightning, arrows, daggers, punching gloves, hammers, traps, grappling hooks, horns and boomerangs already present.

observations: 可见变化：与11月12日相同提示词样本并排观察，三个主按钮由左上横排改为左侧竖排，HP/MP/XP移到其右；角色区由男性头像改成狮子旗徽，等级由42变为47，属性内容及排列改变。
可见变化：八格背包及青色长剑选中框仍在，今天增加INVENTORY (8)标题；弹窗边角与徽章改变，导航QUESTS改为TALENTS。底部改为LEGENDARY/EQUIPPED/BUFF/DEBUFF徽章、ON/OFF开关和CHECKED/UNCHECKED复选框，未出现昨日单选和下拉控件。
文字与布局：主要按钮、数值条、背包与弹窗清楚，未见画布裁切。细小属性和文字仍需在实际使用尺寸人工复核。
主观判断：竖向按钮使操作区与数值区分工更清楚；底部控件类型则减少，不能将局部偏好归为整体能力进步。
限制：工具未报告实际模型版本与随机种子；相同提示词下的随机差异可能影响结果。本次生成没有训练模型，单次可见变化不能证明模型升级或能力提升。

可见变化：与11月12日并排观察，长剑与斧头由竖向改为斜向，剑护手新增青色宝石；盾面金色交叉饰改为银色曲线分区，药水绳结改到右侧。头盔转向改变，卷轴斜度、印章及红带形状也不同。
保留缺陷：剑、盾、斧等超过单格中央60%，仍未达到四边20%留白；背景取样存在色差，未严格满足统一#171c24。
主观判断：斜向装备轮廓更有动势，但安全留白问题仍在，不能据此判断整体质量提升。

可见内容：4列2行八组静态技能图标，依次为陨石、水浪、荆棘环、三道爪痕、火焰、旋风、三根地刺和青色月弧。荆棘可辨四根珊瑚色刺，地刺基座有两处珊瑚色裂痕。无文字、水印、跨格重叠或画布裁切。
风格与用途：奶油暖底、可可描边、圆润玩具体积；青色表达水风能量，珊瑚红用于伤害。补充元素攻势轮廓，归Q版奇幻的战斗技能。
保留缺陷：图标大多超过单格中央60%，未满足四边20%留白；背景有轻微纹理和色差。月弧旁两条能量短痕与主体分离，未严格满足attached要求。
使用限制：不透明PNG，alpha恒为255；这是未分切的静态图集，不能直接当透明动画sprite使用。
可见内容：4列2行八组增益技能，依次为城墙、晶石灯笼、伞、缠绳锚、握手、五瓣薄荷绿花、青镜片护目镜和金月桂星。全部完整留在各自格内，无文字、水印、跨格重叠或画布裁切。
风格与用途：奶油可可材质、蜂蜜金行动奖励、青色能量和薄荷绿治疗语义明确，五瓣花数量可辨；与旧支援图集的药水、心形等题材分开。归Q版奇幻的战斗技能。
保留缺陷：墙、锚、握手和月桂等超过单格中央60%，未满足20%留白；背景并非完全均匀纯色，伞旁青色偏转短痕与主体分离。
使用限制：不透明静态图集，alpha恒为255，未分切或去底；技能含义仍需应用内名称辅助。
